scope: Profile the corrected Q8_0 lane8/shared MXFP4 down GPU path and test whether empty CPU fallback bookkeeping after batch success is the remaining bottleneck.

empty_fallback_skip_patch_attempt.hypothesis: If all matrix_row_counts are zero after GPU batch, skip CPU fallback prepare/barriers/loop and reduce fallback_t0.
empty_fallback_skip_patch_attempt.source_change: Temporarily added an early return in ggml_compute_forward_mul_mat_id when no CPU fallback rows remain after GPU stream attempts.
empty_fallback_skip_patch_attempt.reason: The fallback_t0 and wall time did not improve. The profile bucket has 17400 calls but only 5800 batch-accepted down calls; the remaining non-down/up-gate style fallback dominates the reported fallback_t0.

conclusion: Down GPU correctness remains fixed, but the corrected full-down Q8_0 lane8/shared path is not a token-rate SOTA. The remaining bottleneck is a combination of down source movement/cache misses plus non-down/up-gate CPU fallback, not an empty fallback bookkeeping path after successful down batch.
next_action: Profile and optimize by tensor role on generalized calibration/dev prompts; future source work must target prompt-general simultaneous reduction of gate/source movement and up/down fallback or provide a hard-bound with min >= 5.5 tok/s before implementation.
